public_note: Noether RA77 German cumulative targeted Paper 17 footnote-continuity repair after RA76. It fixes source-title/header continuity, removes an artificial duplicate Paper 17 split header before Section 5, repairs the Section 5 footnote counter, and makes formula (39) source footnote markers 21 and 22 explicit. Targeted repair only: not full Paper 17 certification, not a critical edition, and not multilingual propagation.

files.coverage: German cumulative TeX/PDF after RA76, focused on Paper 17: Emmy Noether and W. Schmeidler, `Moduln in nichtkommutativen Bereichen, insbesondere aus Differential- und Differenzenausdrücken`, Mathematische Zeitschrift 8 (1920), pp.1-35.
files.findings: Package README and applied-fixes CSV report four targeted repairs: restore the full source title including `Differential- und Differenzenausdrücken`; replace an artificial second Paper 17 section header before Section 5 with a continuation note; set the Section 5 continuation footnote counter to 12 so the first continuation note renders as 13; and force formula (39) display footnote markers/texts to source markers 21 and 22, then reset the counter to 22. Local pdfinfo reports a 398-page A4 candidate PDF, same page count as RA76.
files.limitations: Targeted footnote-counter/rendering repair only. It does not certify the full Paper 17 body, does not provide global source closure, does not change Paper 34 continuation blocks, does not update non-German branches, and is not a critical edition.
